description: Start a fix loop: measure the app and keep the result as the baseline recheck compares with. Scenarios (default all the app registered) run the median of several runs after a warm-up, each from a clean start (the app's reload). Or a recording: a .kfrec.json file (with sourceMap for a preview build), or "current" for the last recording; each of its problems is then verified by a scenario that reproduces it, by playing the recording back (UI-thread, rendering and layout problems only), or marked Not verifiable. Returns the problems ranked, each with a short ref (P1…), where it is, evidence, the fix, how it will be verified, and the motion that must keep working. With field (a Motion Vitals problem id from field_problems, like SHOP-12), it also says whether that call site dropped frames here: reproduced or not reproduced. Takes minutes on a big app.

field.description: A Motion Vitals field problem id (SHOP-12): say whether its call site dropped frames in this check. Needs KEYFRAMER_VITALS_READ_KEY.

recording.description: A .kfrec.json file (a name in .keyframer/recordings, or a path), or "current" for the last recording.

reload.description: Reload the app before each scenario (default true; apps that cannot reload run their replay).

runs.description: Measured runs per scenario; the median counts. Default 3.

scenarioStub.description: With a recording: write a registerScenario stub made from its screens and gestures to this file, when some problems have no scenario.

scenarios.description: Scenario names (inspector_status lists them). Default: all. With recording: the scenarios that may verify it.

settleMs.description: Keep recording after each run. Default 800.

sourceMap.description: With a recording from a preview build: that build's .map file.

name: check
